source_first_method.source_first_direction: Recover all 260 frozen original publisher PDF text-layout blocks from official SHA-pinned 51-page version, then preserve exact parent page, parent SSC candidate owner set, printed line span and block SHA. Do not equate page-to-SSC link with block-level semantic occurrence certification.
source_first_method.reverse_direction: For each existing L05 SSC identity recover all candidate parent pages and their original block locations. No claim that all of the parent's source meanings are actually expressed by every block.
